$comment: DS-6 stub (created by PRO-231): the component/export manifest for agent consumers. DS-6 owns the final schema — adopt or migrate these entries. `kind` is one of component | composable | util | data.

entries.name: channels
entries.description: Social-channel registry: {label, brandColor, fg, monochrome, icon} per platform (8: instagram, linkedin, x, facebook, youtube, tiktok, google_my_business, bluesky) + resolveChannel/channelBrand/channelIds. Sole home of brand hex (sanctioned token exception).

entries.name: status
entries.description: Status conventions: STATUS_COLORS map (status id -> semantic color: success/info/warning/error/neutral) as the single badge-coloring mechanism, plus EN/PT label dictionaries (STATUS_MESSAGES), statusColor/statusLabel/statusLabelKey/normalizeStatus/statusIds.

entries.name: formatDate
entries.description: Locale-aware, UTC-stable date formatter (Intl-based, no date-fns). formatDate(value, { locale, style }) — defensive: empty -> '', unparseable strings pass through.

entries.name: copyToClipboard
entries.description: Framework-agnostic clipboard write: navigator.clipboard with hidden-textarea/execCommand fallback. Never throws; resolves boolean.

entries.name: useClipboard
entries.description: Composable wrapper over copyToClipboard preserving the `const { copy } = useClipboard()` call-site shape.

entries.name: CcmChannelBadge
entries.description: Brand-colored channel badge (icon + label) driven by the channel registry. Props: channel, label?.

entries.name: CcmChannelIcon
entries.description: Channel id -> platform SVG mark (alias-aware; neutral globe fallback). Props: channel.

entries.name: CcmStatusBadge
entries.description: Status badge rendering the STATUS_COLORS mechanism via themed --ui-* variables. Props: status, label?, locale? (en/pt).

entries.name: CcmIconGoogleMyBusiness
entries.description: Google G mark (fixed multi-color fills; internal-onboarding use only per Google brand guidelines).
